_provenance: Hand-encoded on 2026-09-07 from wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Twitch
(V26.17 era), cross-checked against ddragon 16.17.1 and Riot's own 16.17
game files (raw.communitydragon.org/16.17/game/data/characters/twitch/
twitch.bin.json): every base, ratio, cooldown, stack count and duration
below agrees between the wiki and the bin (the bin's DataValues carry a
rank-0 entry ahead of ranks 1-5; the passive's DamagePerSecond calc has
breakpoints at levels 5/9/13/17). The meraki snapshot is from 25.08 and
stale on two counts the stat layer works around: AD growth 3.1 (3 since
V26.01 - the snapshot's riot.json, read from the same bin, wins over
meraki when ddragon publishes its 0) and an attack windup of 18.75%
(Riot's cast offset -0.098084 gives 20.192%, the wiki's figure).
Season-2026 history: V26.01 AD growth 3.1 -> 3, AS growth 3.38% -> 3%,
Ambush attack speed 45-65% -> 40-60%; V26.04 health growth 104 -> 98,
armor growth 4.2 -> 4; V26.09 Deadly Venom applies on-hit again (so
phantom hits and a second Spellblade on-hit apply a stack); V26.16 base
MR 30 -> 33, growth 1.3 -> 1.1. Skill order E > Q > W is the guide
sites' consensus; Riot's files carry no recommended order for him.
Modeling choices the sources do not settle are in the notes below and
in `notes` (shown by the dashboard): Ambush is cast before the fight
and never recast; Venom Cask is thrown at the opening and only while
the stacks are short of six; Contaminate waits for six stacks; the
venom ticks once a second from its first application.
Base stats are NOT duplicated here - the stat layer reads them from
data/builds/champions/<patch>/twitch/. This file is only what no
structured source has: the kit's damage logic and its timing rules.
name: Twitch
notes: Twitch opens from Ambush's camouflage: its 40-60% attack speed runs for 6 s from the first attack or cask that breaks it, and Ambush is never recast (the 1 s fade would cost more attacks than the buff returns in a fight this long).
Spray and Pray is cast at t=0 from camouflage: +30/45/60 bonus AD and +300 range for 6 s, no damage of its own; a lone dummy takes every bolt in full.

Venom Cask is thrown at the opening (a stack on impact, one a second for 3 s from the cloud) and only while the target is short of six stacks; Contaminate is cast the moment six stacks are up and it is off cooldown, never earlier to finish a kill.
Deadly Venom ticks once a second (true damage, 1-5 by level plus 3% AP per stack) and every on-hit refreshes it, phantom hits included.

attack.note: windup = 30% + Riot's attack cast offset -0.098084 (the wiki's 20.192%); kept for the record, nothing reads it. Spray and Pray's bolts use a slower animation (0.389 / 1.333 s in the bin) that the engine does not model: attacks land at their tick

perStackPerSecond.note: 1/2/3/4/5 at levels 1/5/9/13/17 (the bin's breakpoints), +3% AP, per stack each second

deadlyVenom.note: applied on-hit by basic attacks (Guinsoo phantom hits and Dusk and Dawn's second on-hit included, V26.09) and by Venom Cask; every application refreshes the 6 s and all stacks lapse together. Modeled as one true-damage instance of stacks x per-stack every second from the first application (the last tick at expiry), the cadence unbroken by refreshes; not ability damage, so no burns, Shojin or Muramana ride it

Q.name: Ambush
Q.note: cast before the fight: the buff starts when the camouflage breaks - the first attack, or the opening cask (Spray and Pray does not break it). Never recast: the attack speed is granted only on breaking stealth, so a recast means a 1 s fade without attacking (the wiki: attacking during it ends Ambush), which costs more than the 6 s buff returns inside a 15 s fight

W.name: Venom Cask
W.note: no damage of its own: a stack on impact (the cask lands as it is thrown), then one a second for 3 s from the cloud, which the dummy never leaves. Thrown when ready while the target is short of six stacks - at the opening and, in a fight this length, never again; the slow is damage-irrelevant

E.name: Contaminate
E.note: one physical instance (base plus the per-stack physical) and one magic instance (the per-stack AP part, skipped at 0 AP), both ability damage. Cast the moment six stacks are up and it is off cooldown, never earlier to finish a kill. Spray and Pray's bonus AD counts as bonus AD here

R.name: Spray and Pray
R.note: no damage of its own: bonus AD (it feeds attacks, Contaminate's ratio and the AD ratio of item actives) and range for 6 s from the cast at t=0, made from camouflage without breaking it. A lone dummy takes each bolt in full; the engine's standard 0.25 s cast lockout still delays the first attack
